entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ComplexCollection + ToJson(): DetectChanges throws "must be initialized to a non-null value" when a nullable nested complex property containing a collection is set to null #38632
  • Cosmos: preserve unmapped properties #38631
    Backlog
  • Possible issue in JsonReaderData commented by copilot on off-topic pr #38630
  • Allow safe numerical comparisons across types #38629
    Backlog
  • JSON-absent required complex collection materializes as null under ComplexProperty().ToJson(), then throws InvalidOperationException in PrepareToSave on save #38625

Closed

  • Cosmos: Projecting out nested documents retrieves the entire document #34067
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Owned entity type collection gets wrongly projected out as null when inside an anonymous object projection #31696
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Materializer rounds when deserializing floating point numbers as fixed point numbers #38138
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Allow to use a custom JSON serializer #17306
    11.0.0
  • new issue #38626
  • EF Core 10.0.9 fails to translate nested OData SelectAll<T>/SelectAllAndExpand<T> wrapper projections that worked in 10.0.8 #38628
